events.title: Ten months after being sacked by 맨체스터 유나이티드, Ron Atkinson returns to football for a second spell as manager of 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 .
아스널 striker Charlie Nicholas hands in a transfer request after manager 조지 그레이엄 dropped him in favour of Perry Groves as strike-partner to new signing Alan Smith .
질링엄 score a club record 10–0 victory over 체스터필드 , a week after defeating Southend 8–1.

25 리버풀 fans are extradited to Belgium on manslaughter charges in connection to the Heysel Stadium disaster , in which 39 spectators (most of them Italian) were crushed to death at the 1985 European Cup Final . 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 's £400,000 bid for 더비 카운티 winger Nigel Callaghan is accepted, but the player turns down the chance to move – less than a year after he joined the East Midlands club for barely a third of that amount.
Brazilian international striker Mirandinha gets his first goals for 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, scoring twice in a 2–2 draw at Old Trafford against 맨체스터 유나이티드.
Manager Bryan 해밀턴 brings Mike Newell to 레스터 시티 from 루턴 타운 for £350,000.
Defender David Bardsley moves between First Division strugglers 왓퍼드 and 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 for £265,000. 찰턴 애슬레틱 sign Wales striker Andy Jones from Third Division side 포트 베일 .
에버턴 sign Scotland midfielder Ian Wilson from 레스터 시티 for £300,000. 리버풀 defender Steve Nicol scores a hat-trick in a 4–1 away league win over 뉴캐슬 유나이티드.
테리 베너블스 , former manager of 크리스털 팰리스 and 퀸스 파크 레인저스, is sacked after three years as manager of Spanish giants 바르셀로나 .
Tommy Docherty is appointed manager of GM Vauxhall Conference side Altrincham .
John Aldridge reaches the 10-goal mark in the league for 리버풀 after just seven games, scoring a hat-trick in their 4–0 home win over 더비 카운티.

퀸스 파크 레인저스, without a top division league title to their name, finish the month as leaders of the First Division, three points ahead of 리버풀, who have two games in hand. 찰턴 애슬레틱 are bottom, with four points from eight matches. 브래드퍼드 시티 top the Second Division, with 헐 시티 second. 크리스털 팰리스 and newly promoted 미들즈브러 and 스윈던 타운 occupy the play-off places.
